brief.scope: Item 49 slice session-budget (S), plan 20260904T172250Z-plan-grok-2c8a8f. Owner 2026-09-04: watchdog should have stopped you. A matrix row on every tool call; no grant escape. Ceilings SESSION_TURNS_CEILING=100 SESSION_AVG_CONTEXT_CEILING=200000 SESSION_REFUSALS_CEILING=10 from the churn analysis (finding 1: merge is the ruling). Frozen command: python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/devlane/hooks/tests -p test_matrix.py

findings.claim: Cases exercise only Bash and Write. An implementation that allows every other tool before checking the budget would pass, violating the every-tool-call contract.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re; s="\n".join(Path("ops/devlane/hooks/tests/test_matrix.py").read_text().splitlines()[1311:1547]); print("Read" in s, sorted(set(re.findall(r"payload_(bash|write)", s))))'

findings.claim: No over-budget case triggers a dispatch row. An implementation evaluating session-budget after scope-cap, bucket-command, or dispatch-by-hand would pass while returning the wrong refusal class.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; s="\n".join(Path("ops/devlane/hooks/tests/test_matrix.py").read_text().splitlines()[1311:1547]); print("dispatch(" in s)'

findings.claim: Tests delete configuration keys but never vary a present ceiling. An implementation that validates key presence and hard-codes 100/200000/10 would pass without reading configured values.
The over-turns transcript contains only assistant usage rows. An implementation counting every JSONL line as a turn would produce the same 101 and pass.
The average-context case contains one usage row. Implementations using the session sum or maximum instead of the arithmetic mean are indistinguishable.
Every planted tool result contains a refusal marker. An implementation counting all tool-result blocks as refusals would return 11 and pass.
The generic [matrix: marker is represented only by [matrix:hand-write]. An implementation hard-coded to that class would pass while missing other matrix refusals.
Deny plants are one over each ceiling and the allow plant is far below. An implementation using >= instead of > would pass while denying sessions exactly at a ceiling.
Each case invokes the hook once for its transcript. An implementation suppressing session-budget after its first denial would pass despite the requirement to deny every later tool.
findings.reproduce: python3 -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; t=ast.parse(Path("ops/devlane/hooks/tests/test_matrix.py").read_text()); print([(n.name, sum(isinstance(x, ast.Call) and isinstance(x.func, ast.Attribute) and x.func.attr in {"run_hook", "run_bash"} for x in ast.walk(n))) for n in ast.walk(t) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith("test_session_budget_")])'

findings.claim: The test named unreadable plants only a nonexistent path. An implementation handling FileNotFoundError but failing on an existing directory, permission denial, or malformed JSONL would pass.
Budget reasons prove the measured number and hand-off remedy but do not require the expected clause to name the exceeded configured ceiling. A generic expected clause would pass.
